causality.monthly_cutoff: first closed M15 decision_time present in each validation calendar month
causality.training_decision_rule: decision_time < first validation-month closed M15 decision_time
causality.training_resolution_rule: maturity_ns <= first validation-month closed M15 decision_time
causality.calibration_window: immediately preceding complete calendar month only
causality.validation_window: current calendar month only and scored after model/threshold freeze

metric_details.p90_label_lift: selected positive rate minus unconditional positive rate, absolute proportion
metric_details.score_psi: calibration-month equal-frequency decile bins applied to validation-month scores; epsilon 1e-6
metric_details.feature_psi: same decile PSI per frozen feature, diagnostic only; median, P90 and maximum reported
metric_details.calibration_slope: unregularized diagnostic logistic slope of validation label on score logit
metric_details.class_weight: positive label weight = clip(1 / resolved training positive rate, 0.5, 3.0); negative weight = 1.0

fail_closed: exactly 100 frozen causal OHLC features required
missing previous-month calibration makes schedule-month unavailable
insufficient train rows or positive-label count makes schedule-month unavailable
any leakage audit violation aborts the run
